caption: Apparently my Mac's upgrade was putting Linux inside it lmao. A 4 GB VM beat macOS at pnpm installs in all four repos I tested; same Mac, warm caches: https://gkoreli.com/why-worktree-setup-is-slow-on-macos
altText: Infographic: 'My Mac lost to the Linux VM inside it. At installing dependencies.' One M5 Mac, two OS environments. Five-run median default warm-cache pnpm 12 installs (macOS versus Linux VM): T3 Code 8.12s versus 2.10s; Next.js 4.56s versus 1.56s; Vite 1.82s versus 0.48s; SvelteKit 0.59s versus 0.13s. Host: 10 logical CPUs, 24 GB RAM. VM: 4 vCPUs, 4 GB RAM. Offline, frozen lockfiles. Install times only; OS, storage and resources differ. The terminal is an illustration.
